g.text: Hey Lettie, I have a favor to ask you.
Hey Lettie, what do you think about tabletop roleplaying games?
So I suppose I'll hear you out
I know this'll sound like a massive waste of time, but Amir wants to get us all to play a game with him called Fables & Frontiers.
Amir really wants us all to play Fables & Frontiers with him. It's really important to him.
Why do I get the feeling I'm about to be?
It does sound like a massive waste of time
And like pulling my own teeth out with a pair of rusty pliers
What that escuincle thinks is important and what IS important are very different
I do not have time for this
Because someone else IS right now
Is what you want ACTUALLY important?
And while there's pain that I enjoy
It's not a matter of life and death, so. No. It can wait.
You owe me a favor, though.
Is what you want ACTUALLY important?
You're calling it in for a silly child's game of make believe?
I am. It's worth it, this means a lot to Amir.
Mm... Never mind. I'll save it.
But only AFTER the work day
